content_sections.heading: NEHU Project Research Scientist Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available - 1 for Project Research Scientist [Non Medical (NM)] I.

content_sections.heading: NEHU Project Research Scientist Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: First-class Master's degree (M.Sc., M.E., MTech or equivalent) in mechanical, nanotechnology or biomedical engineering from a recognized University or Institute and/or PhD with experience in computer-aided designing (CAD/CAM) and additive manufacturing (AM) in general with knowledge of biomedical devices designing and rapid prototyping OR For Engineering, a 4-year Bachelor's degree in the relevant field of engineering or technology with 75% and above with sufficient experience in computer-aided designing (CAD) and additive manufacturing in general with knowledge of biomedical devices designing and rapid prototyping. Desirable: Knowledge of prior experience in the chosen field with technical know-how of design and developing 3D printed dental/ medical casts.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEHU Project Research Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a first-class Master's degree in mechanical, nanotechnology, or biomedical engineering, or a PhD. Alternatively, a 4-year Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field with 75% and above is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided for reserved categories as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,000 plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NEHU Project Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with all required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Does NEHU offer any relaxation in age for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, NEHU offers age relaxation for reserved categories, which will be as per the norms set by ICMR.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Experience in computer-aided designing (CAD/CAM) and additive manufacturing (AM) is required. Knowledge of biomedical devices designing and rapid prototyping is also essential. Prior experience in the chosen field with technical know-how of design and developing 3D printed dental/medical casts is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article. The application is to be submitted via email.
